reviews.conclusion: Video/options settings are visible during the portal transition and briefly again afterward. Combined menu time is approximately 1.25-2.25 s, compatible with the -1.8333 s deficit.

Pause/options menus before and after a narrow game-window capture are visible. Menus alone cover approximately 1.25-2.25 s and are compatible with the -1.5 s deficit, but the obscured interval leaves total pause state uncertain. This is not an exact timing closure.
Fortress fighting contains settings menus at proxy 9-10 s, giving 1-1.5 s sampled bounds compatible with the 1.217 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
